text.cn: 女人街、球鞋店、小吃蒸汽。密度高到像被轻轻挤压的城市海绵。有人边走边讲价，有人边走边打游戏。
text.en: Ladies’ Market, sneakers, snack steam. Density like a lightly squeezed city sponge. Bargaining and mobile games, both walking.

feedback.cn: 蛋挞很烫，心情不烫。你开始喜欢这种「吵但有秩序」的吵。
feedback.en: Egg tart hot; mood not. You like this loud-but-ordered loud.

text.cn: 买球鞋/电子配件：钱包做深蹲。

feedback.cn: 袋子变多。回国行李额开始在脑海闪红灯。
feedback.en: Bags multiply. Baggage allowance flashes red in your mind.

feedback.cn: 你学会了贴墙走。旺角教会你：个人空间是奢侈品。
feedback.en: You learn to walk along walls. Mong Kok lesson: personal space is luxury.

text.cn: 旺角日结束。耳朵还在响，脚还在前进。
text.en: Mong Kok ends. Ears still ringing; feet still moving.
